html:
If you are staying in Da Nang and planning to visit Ba Na Hills, Vietlook Travel offers a round trip private car service from Da Nang to Ba Na Hills with an experienced local driver.

This private transfer is ideal for travelers who want a comfortable and stress-free journey while enjoying full flexibility in departure time and sightseeing schedule.

Da Nang to Ba Na Hills Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Da Nang city center to Ba Na Hills is approximately thirty kilometers one way. The transfer by private car takes around forty five minutes to one hour, depending on traffic conditions.

With a private car, you will be picked up directly at your hotel and dropped off at the Ba Na Hills entrance, then transferred back to Da Nang after your visit.

Flexible Round-Trip Private Car Service

By booking a Da Nang to Ba Na Hills private car with Vietlook Travel, you will enjoy:

  • Flexible departure time based on your plan

  • Door-to-door pick-up and drop-off

  • Privacy and comfort throughout the journey

  • Freedom to enjoy Ba Na Hills without time pressure

You may stay at Ba Na Hills as long as agreed in advance with our travel experts.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Clean and modern vehicles with strong air conditioning

  • Safety seat belts in all seats

  • Experienced drivers familiar with Ba Na Hills routes

  • Free baby seat available upon request

Vehicle options include sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles.
